# FHIR ModelInfo: Primitive and Code Types

Each of these types wraps one `value` element of a System type. FHIR primitives are the lowercase names. The capitalized names are the code types the model generates for required bindings (for example `FHIR.ObservationStatus`), each a `FHIR.Element` with a `System.String` value. FHIRHelpers converts each of them to its System type (see [conversions.md](conversions.md)).
